name: ecosystem-manager
description: Ecosystem Manager CLI surface. Single source of truth for the proto-bound discovery domain: schema-validated against cli-manifest/v1 and cross-validated against the DiscoveryService proto descriptors at endpoints-generation time. Loaded by cli/main.go via cliapp.LoadFromManifest. The REST domains (tasks, queue, steer, logs) are not proto-bound and remain code-registered CommandGroups.
